description: Keyword coverage parity cases for retrieval_stats (Codeinwp/hyve#330), shared with the Hyve Connect platform: both implementations must produce the same term_count, matched and coverage for every case. term_count is the number of diagnostic patterns built from the query; matched is the most patterns one candidate's title + ' ' + content matches (0 with no candidates); coverage is matched / term_count rounded to 4 places, null when term_count is 0. In retrieval_stats a term_count of 0 is recorded as null for all three fields. Accents fold by WordPress's default (en_US) rules whatever the site's locale, after NFC normalization (WordPress only normalizes when PHP's intl normalizer is available; without it, decomposed non-Latin marks stay decomposed in Lite).

cases.name: the best hit need not rank first
terms match word prefixes, not infixes
index stopwords and short words do not count
